organization.short_description:
Slack is a cloud-based team communication platform developed by Slack Technologies, LLC, a subsidiary of Salesforce. Launched in 2013, Slack has become a core business unit within the Salesforce Customer 360 ecosystem. The platform aims to enhance productivity by replacing fragmented email and siloed tools with a unified, channel-based messaging system. It connects people, processes, data, and AI in a conversational interface, making work more efficient and enjoyable.

Slack operates on a freemium model, offering both free and paid plans. Key features include channel-based messaging, voice and video calls, workflow automation, and secure file sharing. The platform integrates with hundreds of business applications, allowing seamless collaboration. With over 200,000 paying organizations globally, Slack is widely used by enterprises, sales teams, and startups to streamline communication and improve collaboration across various regions, including the Americas, Europe, and Asia Pacific.
